c1-01-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Conceding a Point
c1-01-01.scenario: In a seminar on a disputed theory, the tutor asks whether you accept it.
c1-01-01.prompt: Tell the tutor that the theory is disputed, but that you still defend it.
cues: Concede that the theory is disputed
Say that a lot of data speaks for it
c1-01-01.target: Jóllehet az elmélet vitatott, sok adat szól mellette.
c1-01-01.english: Although the theory is disputed, a lot of data speaks for it.
c1-01-01.canDo: I can concede a point in an essay with jóllehet, noha or ámbár.

c1-01-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Planning an Essay
c1-01-02.scenario: An editor asks how you will build the chapter of your essay.
c1-01-02.prompt: Tell the editor that you will present two sides of the question.
c1-01-02.target: Egyfelől bemutatom a mai vitákat, másfelől a történeti előzményeket.
c1-01-02.english: On the one hand I will present today's debates, on the other hand the historical background.
c1-01-02.canDo: I can balance two views with egyfelől … másfelől.

c1-01-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Naming the Flaw
c1-01-03.scenario: A seminar reader says your classmate's plan looks good, and asks if you agree.
c1-01-03.prompt: Agree that the plan is good, then name its problem.
cues: Say it is a good plan
c1-01-03.target: Szép terv, csakhogy senki sem vállalja a munkát.
c1-01-03.english: A fine plan, except that nobody takes on the work.
c1-01-03.canDo: I can set two opposite views side by side with ezzel szemben and ellenben.

c1-01-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Drawing a Conclusion
c1-01-04.scenario: A journalist asks what follows from the new data about the debate.
c1-01-04.prompt: Tell the journalist what the new data means for the question.
cues: Refer back to the new data
Say we must rethink the question
c1-01-04.target: Ennek fényében újra kell gondolnunk a kérdést.
c1-01-04.english: In light of this, we must rethink the question.
c1-01-04.canDo: I can draw a conclusion with ennek fényében and mindebből következően.

c1-01-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Duty of the Intellectual
c1-01-05.scenario: After reading the text about Babits' essay, the tutor asks what it says about the írástudó.
c1-01-05.prompt: Tell the tutor what the text says about the duty of the írástudó.
cues: Say what the írástudó must not do
Say what the írástudó must defend instead
c1-01-05.target: A szöveg szerint az írástudó nem szolgálhatja ki a napi politikát, hanem az örök mércéket védi.
c1-01-05.english: According to the text, the intellectual must not serve daily politics but defends the lasting standards.
c1-01-05.canDo: I can follow the argument of a short text about Babits' essay 'Az írástudók árulása'.

c1-01-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up a Debate
c1-01-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a seminar the tutor asks you to sum up the debate.
c1-01-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the debate: the argument, its flaw and your conclusion.
cues: Concede that the argument seemed convincing
c1-01-consolidation.target: Jóllehet az érvelés meggyőzőnek tűnt, az alapja hibás volt; ennek fényében nem fogadhatjuk el.
c1-01-consolidation.english: Although the argument seemed convincing, its basis was flawed; in light of this we cannot accept it.
c1-01-consolidation.canDo: I can recognise concession, balanced pairs and contrast in an argument.
